participation.context: Copied the leaf and did not head it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote the leaf fair by one candle. You did not put a title, a number, or a name on it.

title: Fair-copied a sonnet by one candle

participation.context: Filed the leaf and did not speak it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read the copy, left every word, and put it with the two older leaves. You did not read it into the room.

title: Laid the third leaf in the folder
